points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Production bf6e816 and final b962bf5 fv_solver.cpp:229–255,421–437 read pressure gradient for temperature slot via grad_off(1+q); correction replaces along-connecting-direction component but generally retains wrong transverse component. :449–462 and :718–725 project tangential shear; no-slip surface velocity is zero.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Production bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:1049–1094 uses SGS with lagged gradients/limiter; selected steady metadata records every inner target missed, but separate outer target and force plateau govern convergence.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: bf6e816 fv_solver.cpp:893–926 refreshes gradients/limiter once per physical step and tests frozen-coefficient residual; zero reported misses do not prove fully refreshed nonlinear target. St≈0.11281 for t>=105 but ≈0.075 peak for t>=100.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Same revision bf6e816 and matching step-0 Re20 force rows, but settled np4/8 Cl differs by 0.40238 and Cd by 0.07007; Selected root session confirms matching np4 controls and fresh start; DQ4 applies. Numerical rank sensitivity material.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
